images.title: Twice 5² + 6² is 11² + 1²
images.purpose: Compares two 5 by 5 squares and two 6 by 6 squares with one 11 by 11 square and one 1 by 1 square, both 122.
images.composition: A before and after comparison: four squares on the left, two squares on the right, with an equals gap. Plain white background, lots of empty space around the main object, no scenery, no people, no extra text.
images.exact_structure: Left group: two teal (#0072B2) squares of side 5 units and two amber (#E69F00) squares of side 6 units, drawn to scale in a row, plain fills; label '2 × (5² + 6²) = 122' below. Right group: one reddish purple (#CC79A7) square of side 11 units and beside it one tiny reddish purple square of side 1 unit; label '11² + 1² = 122' below. Small labels '6 + 5 = 11' and '6 − 5 = 1' above the right group. Exactly 4 squares on the left and 2 on the right.
